src: Civils Prelims 2023
s:
Consider the following statements :
Statement-I : In the post-pandemic recent past, many Central Banks worldwide had carried out interest rate hikes.
Statement-II : Central Banks generally assume that they have the ability to counteract the rising consumer prices via monetary policy means.
Which one of the following is correct in respect of the above statements?
o: Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is the correct explanation for Statement-I
Both Statement-I and Statement-II are correct and Statement-II is not the correct explanation for Statement-I
Statement-I is correct but Statement-II is incorrect
Statement-I is incorrect but Statement-II is correct
x: Both are correct and II explains I: central banks raised rates after the pandemic because they assume monetary tightening can counter rising consumer prices (UPSC official key A).

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2020
s: Where was the Mega Seed Park proposed to be established in Andhra Pradesh?
x: AP's Mega Seed Park was proposed at Tangadancha in Kurnool district.

src: General Studies & Mental Ability (paper title page missing i
s:
In the questions given below, there are two statements marked as
Assertion (A) and
Reason (R).
A: Students of Higher Education can earn some of the credits through online courses of their choice
R: Government of India, Ministry of Education has provided Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs)
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true but R is false.
A is false but R is true.
x: Under the UGC credit framework students can earn credits through SWAYAM MOOCs, which the Ministry of Education provides, so R explains A.

src: AEE Mains 2016
s: The scheme that has entered the Guinness World Record for opening the most bank accounts in a single week
x: PMJDY entered the Guinness World Records for the most bank accounts opened in one week (about 1.8 crore, 23-29 August 2014).

src: APPSC AEEs 2008
s: Income tax on salary is collected and paid directly into the account of:
x: Income tax deducted from salaries (TDS) is a Union tax, so it is paid into the account of the Central Government, not the State, CAG or Accountant General.

src: APPSC Group-II Mains 2019 Paper-3
s: Share of labour force in agriculture sector in AP
x: The APPSC final key for Group-II Mains 2019 Paper-III marks 55% as the share of AP's labour force in agriculture (the initial key also said 55%).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: Approximately how many Crores of families are covered as on 31-03-2017 under Bank-SHG linkage Programme?
x: By 31 March 2017 the SHG-bank linkage programme covered about 10 crore families (about 85 lakh SHGs).

src: Previous paper (title page not in scan)
s: Which of the following statements is true, with regard to present India?
o: Compared to Urban areas, higher percentage of population in rural India suffer from malnutrition
In urban India, malnutrition is not a problem
Compared to rural areas, higher percentage of population in Urban India suffer from malnutrition
Malnutrition levels are equal both in urban and Rural India
x: Malnutrition is higher in rural India (NFHS-5 stunting: rural 37.3% vs urban 30.1%); it is a problem in urban India too. Off-topic (nutrition), moved.

src: Welfare Organiser in AP Sainik Welfare 2017
s: The GST bill was passed in the Rajya Sabha on this day in 2016
x: The Rajya Sabha passed the GST (122nd Amendment) Bill on 3 August 2016 (it became the 101st Amendment). (Off-topic PYQ: moved.)

src: APPSC Assistant Social, BC & Tribal Welfare Officers Mains P
s: As on the appointed day, which of the Assembly Constituencies of Telangana State, had part of their territory in the State of Andhra Pradesh?
x: After the Polavaram ordinance moved the submergence mandals to AP, parts of the Pinapaka, Aswaraopeta and Bhadrachalam Assembly constituencies of Telangana lay in AP.

src: APPSC Group-II 2011
s: The average productivity of rain fed area under cultivation per hectare in Andhra Pradesh is
x: Rain-fed farms in AP yield only about one tonne per hectare, far below irrigated yields of 3-6 t/ha.

src: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
s: Which of the following is more prolific meat animal
x: Rabbits are the most prolific meat animals (short gestation, large litters).

src: Police Constable Final Written Exam 2019
s: In December 2018 the Reserve Bank of India appointed the following committee to decide the appropriate level of reserves needs to maintain by the Reserve Bank of India.
x: In December 2018 the RBI set up the Bimal Jalan Committee on its Economic Capital Framework – the appropriate level of RBI reserves and surplus transfer to the Government (report August 2019).

src: SI Mains Paper-IV 2017
s: As per India Development Report (2004-05) what percentage of Financial amounts is allocated for the development of Technical Education, in 1992-93
x: No source in the library or on the web gives the 1992-93 share of technical education in education spending from the India Development Report 2004-05, so the printed key (18.7) cannot be verified; technical education usually takes well under 10% of education spending, which makes 18.7 doubtful.

src: APPSC Dental Asst. Surgeons, Zilla Sainik Welfare Officers,
s: What is done under Digi dhan Yojana?
o: Digital Locker is provided to Consumers
License granted to merchants for digital transactions
Award of prize to merchants for digital transactions
x: Under Digi-Dhan Vyapar Yojana merchants got prizes for digital transactions (consumers had Lucky Grahak); it is not a locker, licence or plain lottery.

src: APPSC Extension Officer W & CW 2012
s: As per 2011 census, the population of India
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (1,210,193,422); it is added as option 5.
Census 2011 (provisional) counted 1,210,193,422 people (final 1,210,854,977); the four printed figures are all mis-typed versions, none of them correct.

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: Sensorial method of Montessori is closely associated with which of the following?
x: Montessori's sensorial method trains the senses with concrete didactic material, so it is classed with (sense) realism. (Moved to education.)

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test 2019
s: What is the cap on Incentives that will be provided to various Textile, Apparel units under "The Textile, Apparel, and Garments Policy 2018-2023"
o: 100% of Fixed Capital Investment (FCI) for units with Garmenting, Apparel, Made-ups, Integrated Plants, Processing, Technical Textiles operations
75% of Fixed Capital Investment (FCI) for Weaving, Weaving Preparatory, Knitting units
50% of the Fixed Capital Investment (FCI) for Spinning and Ginning operations
x: The Textile, Apparel and Garments Policy 2018-23 capped incentives at 100% of FCI for garmenting, made-ups, integrated, processing and technical textile units, 75% for weaving/knitting and 50% for spinning/ginning – so all of the above.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-II Rural Dev
s: The following scheme is not proposed for convergence with MNREGA?
x: Watershed programmes, RKVY and BRGF were listed for convergence with MGNREGA; Make in India, a manufacturing campaign, was not.

src: TSPSC AEE 2018
s: Green revolution is also called as (one of the following):
x: The Green Revolution is also called the seed-fertiliser-water technology (HYV seeds, chemical fertilisers, irrigation). Off-topic here; moved to Indian economy (agriculture).

src: APPSC Hostel Welfare Officer Grade-II (Male & Female) in AP
s: The theory of achievement motivation was developed by McClelland in which year at Harvard University?
x:
The printed options did not include the correct answer (1961); it is added as option 5.
McClelland's achievement-motivation (n-Ach) theory was set out in 'The Achieving Society' (1961), written at Harvard (he joined in 1956; 'The Achievement Motive' 1953); 1965, 1944, 1949 and 1951 do not fit.
